notes.title: Now Available - ACDSee 15
notes.content:
ACDSee 15 is Now Available on Steam and is 20% off!


Take your photos further than you ever dreamed possible with ACDSee 15. Organize your collection by what, when or where. Edit and add jaw-dropping effects with ease. Then share your best with friends, family and the world through the ACDSee Online cloud, Facebook, Twitter, and e-mail. So simple to use. Yet so amazing the results.
